name: Compounding OpenDollar
oneLiner: cUSDO is OpenEden's non-rebasing wrapper of USDO that compounds T-Bill yield through price appreciation rather than balance changes.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: cUSDO resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

collateral: USDO wrapped into OpenEden's non-rebasing cUSDO format; the wrapper keeps the same Treasury-backed reserve stack as USDO while yield accrues through price appreciation instead of rebasing
pegMechanism: Users can wrap USDO into cUSDO or unwrap cUSDO back into USDO at any time; unlike rebasing USDO, cUSDO compounds by increasing in redeemable USDO per token

mintAuthority.summary: cUSDO is OpenEden's non-rebasing savings-passthrough wrapper of USDO; shares are minted when USDO is wrapped and do not create base USDO supply, so its mint authority is inherited from USDO (usdo-openeden).

controls.label: OpenEden cUSDO wrapper token
controls.capDescription: cUSDO shares are minted/burned by the OpenEden ERC-4626-style wrapper against USDO wrap/unwrap; this share accounting cannot create or destroy base USDO supply.
controls.evidence: Savings-passthrough wrapper: wrapping USDO mints cUSDO whose redeemable USDO per token grows via NAV appreciation; minting only follows USDO deposits and does not expand the parent USDO supply.

controls.label: Inherited USDO (OpenEden) MINTER_ROLE mint path
controls.evidence: Underlying USDO supply is created via AccessControl MINTER_ROLE held by an EOA default-admin, the USDOExpressV2 mint/redeem contract, and a CCIP burn/mint token pool (permissioned-minter, concentrated-admin); cUSDO holds USDO and inherits that base mint authority.

review.evidence: cUSDO (variantOf usdo-openeden, variantKind savings-passthrough) is a non-rebasing wrapper whose shares track wrapped USDO; base mint authority is the inherited USDO permissioned-minter path (concentrated-admin) and is mirrored here.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Wrapper classification follows from coin metadata (variantOf usdo-openeden, savings-passthrough, wrapper reserve); posture mirrors the USDO parent mint authority.
